title: Alibaba Cloud Launches Qwen Book: AI Intelligent Agent Computer Makes Its Debut
excerpt: At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Alibaba Cloud officially launched the AI Agent Computer Qwen Book, which focuses on self-understanding of user intent, continuous
content_html:
At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Alibaba Cloud officially launched the AI Agent Computer Qwen Book, which focuses on self-understanding of user intent, continuous learning, and long-term task execution. The product is equipped with interactive access points such as a Skill keyboard array, global AI keys, and voice handwriting pens, and provides an operational space that supports running heavy tasks 7x24 hours. It optimizes the issue of insufficient collaboration efficiency between applications and Agents in traditional AI office scenarios.

Qwen Book is based on the "OS as Harness" concept, using the Qwen terminal-cloud model as the core, and deeply integrating operating system, application, cloud service, and hardware capabilities. It unifies the management of interactive access points, runtime environment, personal continuous context, and software and hardware control capabilities, building an Agent computing environment that is understandable, memorable, sustainable, and governable. Zhang Xiantao, Vice President of Alibaba Cloud R&D and President of the Terminal Intelligent Computing Business Unit, stated that he hopes Qwen Book will evolve from a hardware tool into a token-driven, continuously growing agent carrier, promoting the advancement of personal intelligence toward RSI.

In terms of ecosystem, Qwen Book has completed compatibility with partners such as Qualcomm, Intel, Logitech, and Kenu, and has integrated Alipay and Qwen Input Method, among other Alibaba applications. It also opens up system interfaces and capability integrations. During the conference, Qwen Book also announced a collaboration with the open-source project Omarchy to jointly explore a new generation of desktop operating systems for Agents.
